title: Credit and Collections Guideline: Uncleared Check Payments in a PrePay Power (Prepaid Metering) Carried-In Credit
content:
When a credit balance is carried into PrePay Power (Prepaid Metering), part of it may rest on a recent check payment that has not had time to clear. The uncleared-payment hold is set from the payment records of the enrolled service account on Electric Service by Rate Schedule: the latest payment, its channel, its posting date and amount, and any payment returned unpaid.

**Rule.** Where the latest payment to the enrolled service account came by mailed check, office check or electronic check, was posted in the one-month window, and a payment to that account was returned unpaid in the twelve-month window, the uncleared-payment hold is the whole of that latest payment. Where such a latest check or electronic check payment was posted in the one-month window and no payment to the account was returned unpaid in the twelve-month window, the uncleared-payment hold is 50 percent of that payment, rounded to the cent. Any other payment record keeps no hold.

**Windows.** A window of a stated number of months takes the records dated after the same day of the month that many months before the current date, through the current date.

### Condition, judgement, result

| Latest payment by mailed check, office check or electronic check | Latest payment posted in the one-month window | A payment returned unpaid in the twelve-month window | Uncleared-payment hold |
|---|---|---|---|
| yes | yes | yes | the whole latest payment |
| yes | yes | no | 50 percent of the latest payment, to the cent |
| yes | no | either | none |
| no (card, cash, kiosk or any other channel) | either | either | none |

### Hypothetical cases (current date 20 May, so the one-month window runs from 21 April through 20 May)

- Latest payment 120.00 by office check on 12 May, no returns in the twelve-month window: hold 60.00.
- The same payment, with one payment returned unpaid in January: hold 120.00.
- Latest payment 85.30 by electronic check on 2 May, no returns: hold 42.65.
- Latest payment by mailed check on 20 April: outside the one-month window, so no hold.
- Latest payment by online card on 15 May: no hold.
